title: Surreal Clock Eye
description: A large wooden cuckoo clock with a giant blue eye for a face sits at the top of the picture dripping blue liquid. Below it a blue scaled mouth pours more blue liquid into swirling water where two hands reach up one with a scaled sleeve and the other with dragon wings on the fingers both wearing rings and touching a large ornate key.
prompt: surreal painting of a wooden cuckoo clock with a giant blue eye as its face dripping blue liquid from the top a large blue scaled open mouth below it pouring streams of blue liquid downward into swirling water at the bottom two human hands reach up from the water one hand has a blue scaled sleeve and rings the other hand has dragon wings on the fingers and rings both hands touch a large ornate key with blue liquid flowing from it feathers quills an anvil and hanging locks surround the scene all in deep blue purple and black tones
